🚨⚪⚫ #Juventus, updates after the #Napoli match:▪️ #McKennie: adductor fatigue, a couple of days to recover.▪️ #Alajbegović: just a knock to the knee, already fine.▪️ #Cabal: only cramps, problem resolved.[IlBianconero]
No concerns at #Juventus for yesterday's bruised players. #Mckennie has a slight fatigue, #Alajbegović and #Cabal only took a knock and are not considered injured.@Sportmania_24[Michele De Blasis]

🚑 The hopes of seeing Weston #Mckennie travel to the Netherlands with #Juventus are minimal, ahead of Thursday's match against #AZAlkmaar, in the Europa League.He remained in the locker room at halftime against #Napoli due to discomfort to his adductors and he will undergo medical tests in the coming hours.Kerim #Alajbegović finished the match with an ice pack on his knee and Juan #Cabal left the pitch in pain.#Spalletti: "Perhaps #Cabal got hurt too, we need to check all three."To the absentees that were already missing against #Napoli the players from the UEFA squad list are now added.[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]
